definition.body: Cepstral-homomorphic-filtering is a signal processing technique that performs filtering by converting a signal to the cepstral domain via log and inverse Fourier transform, applying a filter in the cepstral domain, then reconstructing via forward Fourier transform and exponentiation. Procedure: (1) compute the power spectrum of the input, (2) take logarithm to convert multiplicative convolution to additive, (3) apply inverse Fourier transform to obtain cepstrum, (4) apply homomorphic filter to cepstral coefficients, (5) reconstruct spectrum via forward Fourier transform and exponentiation. Parameters: filter type (lifter, window), lifter cutoff quefrency, filter shape. Persistence: implemented in speech enhancement toolkits, e.g., HTK's cepstral liftering, and described in Oppenheim & Schafer textbooks. e.g.: Oppenheim & Schafer 'Discrete-Time Signal Processing' chapter on homomorphic deconvolution; HTK's cepstral liftering implementation for speech dereverberation; MATLAB's cepstral filtering example for echo removal | not: linear filtering (operates in time/frequency domain, not log-spectrum) [formal: filtratio-cepstralis-homomorphica | substrate: behavior | horizon: a life | explicit: yes]

Procedure: (1) compute the power spectrum of the input, (2) take logarithm to convert multiplicative convolution to additive, (3) apply inverse Fourier transform to obtain cepstrum, (4) apply homomorphic filter to cepstral coefficients, (5) reconstruct spectrum via forward Fourier transform and exponentiation. Parameters: filter type (lifter, window), lifter cutoff quefrency, filter shape. Persistence: implemented in speech enhancement toolkits, e.g., HTK's cepstral liftering, and described in Oppenheim & Schafer textbooks. e.g.: Oppenheim & Schafer 'Discrete-Time Signal Processing' chapter on homomorphic deconvolution; HTK's cepstral liftering implementation for speech dereverberation; MATLAB's cepstral filtering example for echo removal | not: linear filtering (operates in time/frequency domain, not log-spectrum) [formal: filtratio-cepstralis-homomorphica | substrate: behavior | horizon: a life | explicit: yes]
